sections.overview: Franck’s sphinx is a large moth in family Sphingidae.
sections.identification: Adults are grey with tan markings; females lay eggs singly.
sections.habitat: It occurs in eastern U.S. hardwood forests.
sections.diet: Larvae feed on ash and fringe tree; adults take nectar.
sections.behavior: Adults are mainly recorded from late spring through summer.
sections.ecology: It belongs to the same genus as the Canadian and Chisoya sphinxes.
sections.conservation: NatureServe gives a global rank of G4G5 and notes northern declines.
